entries.zh: 保护、庇护（如神之护佑、如军队护卫城池）
entries.en: to protect, to guard (as God does, as the militia guards the city)
to shelter and bless, to protect

entries.zh: 帮助、维护、偏护（为某人出力）
entries.en: to help, to protect, to favour (to act on someone's behalf)
entries.notes: M 栏 cȳ 与 H 為 的闽南读音不合，释义依 H、R（ūy＝為）及西语 amparar/favorecer 定，音读存疑。

entries.en: to lend one's strength, to help exert force together
entries.notes: L 栏 "aser fuerza una" 语句残损，H 恊（協 异体）与 M hiăp 可定「协力」，M 首音节 tâ 不明。

entries.en: to join forces with one heart, to contribute strength in concert
to help, to remedy, to succour

entries.zh: 帮（当差、任职者）的忙、从旁协助
entries.en: to assist one holding office, to give help to an official
to help with money raised in common, to subsidize
entries.notes: 第二音节声调标记污损（T99），字形 幫貼 与西语 "de comunidad con dineros" 清晰，义项不受影响。

entries.en: to help, to deliver, to rescue
to help with alms, to relieve the poor
to succour, to rescue and protect
entries.notes: M 栏首音节 giâ 与 H 救（giû）不合，H 救護 与 R guiūn hū 一致，义项可定。

entries.en: to help in necessity, to give emergency relief
entries.notes: L 栏末 "mte" 为缩略且文义不全，H 救急 与 M、R 一致，义项从「急难」。

entries.en: to answer a call for help, to bring relief
to come to the rescue, to go to help
entries.notes: H 栏 來/求 字形有疑；R láy 指向 來救，而 M giû giù 近 求救，二读方向相反，故降等。

entries.en: to guard, to defend, to protect
to fund, to supply with means
to support someone, to provide for someone's living
to assist in work, to lend a hand at labour
entries.notes: L 栏末 "hu" 为残字，labrar 可指耕作、做工或雕琢，此处取「劳作」义。

entries.en: to help by interceding, to speak on someone's behalf
to help with words, to put in a good word
entries.notes: H 作 贊口、M 作 贊嘴（chǔy＝嘴），R 却作 贊言，疑承上条 贊言 而衍，义仍为口头相助。

entries.en: to approve and further, to back, to second

entries.zh: 占卜求助（占）〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.en: to divine, to seek aid by divination (占); [damaged text, sense uncertain]
entries.notes: L 栏 "ayudara n del gr stinien" 不成句、严重残缺，仅 H 占 与 M、R chiâm 可读，义项无从定夺。

entries.en: to protect, to bless (as God does the saints)
to bless and protect (as God does)
entries.notes: H 栏 祐/佑 字形有疑（异体，义无别）；M "hoûiū" 系 保祐 连写。
